items.title: 比较对象的对称性
items.brief: than 前后必须同类，缺名词用 that/those of

concept.summary: 判定标准：than 或 as 前后必须是同一范畴、同一语法层级的东西。前项是“某人的某物”时，后项不能只留人或只留物，要用 that of / those of（或名词性物主代词）把被比较的名词补回同一层级，否则就是“人比城市”“产量比年份”的错误。

sections.h: 对称性检验：把省略部分补全
sections.p: than 后面的成分常被省略，还原后必须与前项同类。检验办法是把 than 后补成完整短语，读一遍看是否“人比人、物比物、数量比数量”。
bullets: The population of Shanghai is larger than that of Beijing.（that = the population）
The ears of a rabbit are longer than those of a cat.（those = the ears）
× The population of Shanghai is larger than Beijing.（人口与城市比）
× The ears of a rabbit are longer than a cat.（耳朵与猫比）

sections.h: that of 与 those of 的选择
sections.p: 替代前项名词时，单数或不可数用 that，复数用 those；指人时也可用 the one / the ones。所有格可以直接替代：than mine / than his。替代词不能省略成 than of。
bullets: 单数或不可数 → that：The climate here is milder than that of the north.
复数 → those：Cars made in Japan are cheaper than those made in Germany.
所有格 → mine/yours：His salary is higher than mine.
× than of Beijing：替代词 that 不能省

sections.p: than 后接代词时，用主格还是宾格取决于补全后它充当什么成分。正式书面语按补全后的成分选格，口语中宾格常见。
bullets: She is taller than I am.（正式，I 作主语）
She is taller than me.（口语，可接受）
He likes her more than I do.（他比她更喜欢她）
He likes her more than me.（他喜欢她胜过喜欢我）

examples.en: The population of Shanghai is larger than that of Beijing.
examples.zh: 上海的人口比北京多。
examples.note: that 替代 the population，前后都是“人口”，比较对象对称。

examples.en: The population of Shanghai is larger than Beijing.
examples.zh: 上海的人口比北京多。
examples.note: 这样写成了人口与城市比较，须补 that of 才能与 the population 对应。

examples.en: The ears of a rabbit are longer than those of a cat.
examples.zh: 兔子的耳朵比猫的长。
examples.note: 前项是复数 the ears，故用 those of 替代。

examples.en: The ears of a rabbit are longer than a cat.
examples.zh: 兔子的耳朵比猫的长。
examples.note: 耳朵与猫不是同类事物，须改为 than those of a cat。

examples.en: Cars made in Japan are cheaper than those made in Germany.
examples.zh: 日本产的汽车比德国产的便宜。
examples.note: those 替代 cars，后项保留了同一层级的分词定语。

examples.en: His monthly salary is higher than mine.
examples.zh: 他的月薪比我的高。
examples.note: 名词性物主代词 mine 替代 my salary，是 that of 结构的等价写法。

examples.en: The climate here is milder than of the north.
examples.zh: 这里的气候比北方温和。
examples.note: 替代词不能省略，须写成 than that of the north。

pitfalls.wrong: The output of this factory is higher than last year.
pitfalls.right: The output of this factory is higher than that of last year.
pitfalls.why: 产量只能与产量比，last year 前必须补 that of 才构成同级比较。

pitfalls.wrong: The students in Class One are more active than Class Two.
pitfalls.right: The students in Class One are more active than those in Class Two.
pitfalls.why: 前项是学生，后项也必须是学生，用 those 替代 students 才能对等。

pitfalls.wrong: The weather in Kunming is better than Beijing.
pitfalls.right: The weather in Kunming is better than that in Beijing.
pitfalls.why: 天气不能与城市比较，单数不可数名词用 that 替代。

contrast.diff: 该知识点解决代词本身的选用；本知识点只关心比较结构里必须补出替代词，否则前后层级不对称。

concept.mnemonic: 前项带 of，后项也带 of；单数 that，复数 those，省了就错。

core: than/as 前后必须同类、同层级
单数或不可数用 that of，复数用 those of
名词性物主代词可直接替代：than mine
替代词不能省：× than of Beijing
检验办法：把 than 后补全，读一遍是否同类相比
review.trigger: 看到 than + 名词，而前项是“X 的 Y” → 立刻补 that/those of

quickCheck.q: The population of A is larger than ___ of B. 填什么？
The ears of a rabbit 后用 that of 还是 those of？
quickCheck.a: those of，因为 ears 是复数。

quickCheck.q: His salary is higher than ___ (I). 怎么写？

drills.stem: The number of students in our school is larger than ___ in theirs.
drills.answer: that
drills.explain: 被比较的是 the number，单数概念，用 that 替代，构成 that in theirs。
drills.trap: those 只能替代复数名词，the number 是单数，用 those 会让前后层级不一致。

drills.stem: The weather in Kunming is milder than ___ in Harbin.
drills.answer: that
drills.hint: 被比较的是 the weather，不可数名词。
drills.explain: weather 是不可数名词，替代时用 that，构成 than that in Harbin，避免天气与城市相比。

drills.stem: The population of India is now larger than China.
drills.answer: The population of India is now larger than that of China.
accept: The population of India is now larger than that of China.
drills.explain: 前项是印度的人口，后项必须也是人口，用 that of China 补出被比较的名词。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The climate here is milder than that of the north.
drills.explain: climate 是不可数名词，用 that 替代，补出 of the north 使前后都是“气候”。

drills.stem: 上海的房价比北京的高。
drills.answer: House prices in Shanghai are higher than those in Beijing.
drills.explain: house prices 是复数，须用 those 替代，否则会写成房价与城市比较。

drills.stem: The students in our class work harder than ___ in Class Two.
drills.answer: those
drills.explain: 前项是复数 the students，替代词用 those，构成 than those in Class Two，前后同为“学生”。
drills.trap: them 是宾格代词，无法带 in Class Two 作后置定语，也无法与 the students 形成同级比较。

items.title: 比较级表最高级
items.brief: 把主语排除在范围外，比较级就是最高级

concept.summary: 判定标准：比较级要表达“最”的意思，必须把比较范围限定为“除主语之外的全部”。三种结构都能做到：否定词 + 比较级、比较级 + than any other + 单数名词、比较级 + than all the other + 复数名词。范围里排除掉主语自身，结构才成立。

sections.p: 这三种结构语义相同，都可以与最高级互换。判断时先看有没有否定词，再看 than 后面是否带 other 或 all the other。
bullets: 否定词 + 比较级：Nothing is more important than health.
比较级 + than any other + 单数名词：He runs faster than any other boy in his class.
比较级 + than all the other + 复数名词：She is taller than all the other girls in her grade.
比较级 + than anyone else：He works harder than anyone else in the team.
never + 比较级：I have never seen a better film.

sections.p: any 若不搭配 other，比较范围里就包含主语自身，句子会变成“他比自己跑得快”的逻辑错误。other 的唯一作用是把主语从范围中排除。
bullets: × He runs faster than any boy in his class.（他在班里，等于比自己快）
√ He runs faster than any other boy in his class.
互换：He is the tallest boy in his class. = He is taller than any other boy in his class.

sections.h: 否定比较级的两个细节
sections.p: “最”的意思由整个否定结构承担，比较级前用不定冠词 a，不用 the；否定词常用 nothing、no、never、few。换成最高级时去掉否定词即可。
bullets: Nothing is more precious than time. = Time is the most precious thing.
I have never heard a more inspiring speech.
× I have never heard the more inspiring speech.
No other student is as diligent as she is.（同级比较的否定形式）

examples.en: Nothing is more important than health.
examples.zh: 没有什么比健康更重要。
examples.note: 否定词 nothing + 比较级，表达“健康最重要”。

examples.en: He runs faster than any boy in his class.
examples.zh: 他比班里任何男孩都跑得快。
examples.note: any boy 包含他自己，逻辑上成了比自己快，须加 other。

examples.en: He runs faster than any other boy in his class.
examples.zh: 他比班里其他任何男孩都跑得快。
examples.note: other 把主语排除出比较范围，比较级在此等于最高级。

examples.en: She is taller than all the other girls in her grade.
examples.zh: 她比同年级其他所有女孩都高。
examples.note: all the other + 复数，同样把主语排除在外。

examples.en: I have never seen a more inspiring speech.
examples.zh: 我从没听过比这更鼓舞人心的演讲。
examples.note: never + a + 比较级，语义等于“这是最鼓舞人心的演讲”。

examples.en: I have never seen the more inspiring speech.
examples.zh: 我从没听过比这更鼓舞人心的演讲。
examples.note: 否定比较级表最高级时用不定冠词 a，the more 是特指比较，语义不通。

examples.en: No other city in China is as large as Shanghai.
examples.zh: 中国没有别的城市像上海这么大。
examples.note: no other + 同级比较 as...as，是最高级的另一种否定写法。

pitfalls.wrong: He is taller than any student in his class.
pitfalls.right: He is taller than any other student in his class.
pitfalls.why: any student 把主语本人也纳入范围，比较出现自我比较的逻辑矛盾，须加 other 排除。

pitfalls.wrong: Nothing is more useful as a good dictionary.
pitfalls.right: Nothing is more useful than a good dictionary.
pitfalls.why: more 是比较级，只能搭配 than；as 用于原级的同级比较 as...as。

pitfalls.wrong: I have never read the better novel.
pitfalls.right: I have never read a better novel.
pitfalls.why: 否定比较级表“最好”时比较级前用不定冠词 a，用 the 会变成特定两本之间的比较。

contrast.diff: 最高级靠 in/of 短语限定范围；比较级表最高级靠 other、all the other 或否定词排除主语，形式不同但语义等价。

concept.mnemonic: 比较级想称“最”，先把主语踢出圈；any 要配 other，否定配 a。

core: 三种结构：否定词 + 比较级 / than any other + 单数 / than all the other + 复数
other 的作用是把主语排除出比较范围
否定比较级用 a + 比较级，不用 the
可与最高级直接互换
never + 比较级也表示“最”
review.trigger: 看到“比较级 + than any” → 检查有没有 other → 没有就是逻辑错误

quickCheck.q: He is taller than any ___ student in his class. 填什么？
“我从没看过更好的电影”怎么写？
quickCheck.a: I have never seen a better film。

quickCheck.q: Nothing is more important than health 相当于什么？
quickCheck.a: Health is the most important thing。

drills.stem: He runs faster than ___ student in his class.
drills.answer: any other
drills.explain: 主语 he 也在班里，必须用 any other 把他排除出比较范围，比较级才等于最高级。
drills.trap: any student 把主语包含在内，句子会变成“他比自己跑得快”，逻辑不成立。

drills.stem: She is more diligent than ___ other student in the grade.
drills.answer: any
drills.hint: 后面已经有 other，这里只缺一个限定词。
drills.explain: than any other student 是固定组合，any 与 other 分工：any 表任一个，other 排除主语。

drills.stem: He is taller than any boy in his class.
drills.answer: He is taller than any other boy in his class.
accept: He is taller than any other boy in his class.
drills.explain: any boy 包含主语 he 本人，须加 other 把主语排除，比较级才能表达“最高”。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Nothing is more important than health.
drills.explain: 否定词 nothing + 比较级 more important，整体表达“健康最重要”。

drills.stem: 他比班上任何其他学生都用功。
drills.answer: He works harder than any other student in his class.
drills.explain: other 把主语排除出比较范围；漏掉 other 就成了与自己比较，逻辑不成立。

drills.stem: He works harder than ___ in the workshop.
drills.answer: anyone else
drills.explain: else 的作用与 other 相同，把主语 he 排除在比较范围之外，比较级才表示“最用功”。
drills.trap: anyone 包含主语本人，等于说“他比自己用功”，逻辑矛盾。

items.title: the same as / different from / superior to
items.brief: 介词由词本身决定，拉丁比较级不接 than

concept.summary: 判定标准：这三个结构的介词由词本身决定，不由“比较”这一语义决定——same 配 as，different 配 from，以 -ior 结尾的拉丁比较级（superior/inferior/senior/junior/prior）配 to。凡拉丁比较级，既不加 than，也不加 more。

sections.p: the same 后接 as 表“同类相同”，接 that 表“同一个”。两者不能互换，区别在所指是同一物还是同类型。
bullets: the same as：Her reaction was exactly the same as mine.
the same ... as：I bought the same phone as you did.（同款）
the same ... that：This is the same phone that I lost last week.（同一部）
not the same as = different from

sections.p: 这一类词本身已含比较义，因此不接 than，也不受 more 修饰。要表示程度差别，用 far、much、slightly 等程度副词。
bullets: superior to / inferior to / senior to / junior to / prior to
This engine is far superior to the one we used before.
× superior than；× more superior
He is three years senior to me.（表年龄差用 senior to）

sections.p: different from 是书面语首选，different to 是英式口语变体，different than 多见于美式且后面常接从句。三种都真实存在，但考试改错以 from 为准。
bullets: My answer is different from yours.（书面首选）
different to 在英式口语中可接受
different than 后常接从句：The result was different than we expected.
× different with：英语中不存在这一搭配

examples.en: This engine is far superior to the one we used before.
examples.zh: 这台发动机比我们以前用的那台好得多。
examples.note: superior 是拉丁比较级，配 to，程度用 far 修饰。

examples.en: This engine is far superior than the one we used before.
examples.zh: 这台发动机比我们以前用的那台好得多。
examples.note: superior 已含比较义，固定搭配 to，不能换成 than。

examples.en: My answer is different from yours.
examples.zh: 我的答案和你的不同。
examples.note: different 的书面固定搭配是 from。

examples.en: My answer is different with yours.
examples.zh: 我的答案和你的不同。
examples.note: different 不与 with 搭配，应改为 different from。

examples.en: Her reaction was exactly the same as mine.
examples.zh: 她的反应和我的一模一样。
examples.note: the same 配 as，exactly 修饰相同的程度。

examples.en: He is three years senior to me.
examples.zh: 他比我大三岁。
examples.note: senior 属拉丁比较级，表年龄差用 senior to，不用 older than。

examples.en: This method is more superior to the old one.
examples.zh: 这种方法比旧方法更优越。
examples.note: superior 已含比较义，不能再加 more，去掉 more 即可。

pitfalls.wrong: This cloth is more superior to that one in quality.
pitfalls.right: This cloth is superior to that one in quality.
pitfalls.why: 拉丁比较级本身已含“更”的意思，叠加 more 属双重比较，去掉 more 即可。

pitfalls.wrong: His view is different than mine.
pitfalls.right: His view is different from mine.
pitfalls.why: than 只服务于比较级；different 的书面固定介词是 from，不接 than。

pitfalls.wrong: She is the same age with me.
pitfalls.right: She is the same age as me.
pitfalls.why: the same 的固定搭配是 as，with 不表示同级相同。

contrast.withTitle: 比较级与最高级的构成
contrast.diff: 普通形容词靠 -er/more 构成比较级并接 than；拉丁比较级词形固定、不接 than，只接 to，也不受 more 修饰。

concept.mnemonic: same 配 as，different 配 from，-ior 一族只认 to。

core: the same as 同类相同；the same ... that 同一个
different from 书面首选，different to 英式口语
superior/inferior/senior/junior/prior + to
拉丁比较级不加 than，也不加 more
程度修饰用 far/much/slightly，不用 more
review.trigger: 看到 same/different/-ior 形容词 → 先想固定介词，再想能不能接 than

quickCheck.q: superior 后面接 than 还是 to？
“他比我大两岁”用 senior 怎么说？
quickCheck.a: He is two years senior to me。

drills.stem: Her reaction was exactly the same ___ mine.
drills.answer: as
drills.explain: the same 的固定搭配是 as，构成 the same as，表示两者完全相同。
drills.trap: like 是介词，表“像”，不能与 the same 构成同级相同的固定结构。

drills.stem: This coffee is quite different ___ the one we had yesterday.
drills.answer: from
drills.explain: different 的固定介词是 from，英式口语中也可用 to；with 不是可选搭配。

drills.stem: This method is more superior to the old one.
drills.answer: This method is superior to the old one.
accept: This method is superior to the old one.
drills.explain: superior 本身已含比较义，不能再受 more 修饰，否则构成双重比较。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: These goods are superior to those we bought last year.
drills.explain: superior 固定接 to；those 替代 goods，保持比较对象对称。

drills.stem: 我的意见和你的不同。
drills.answer: My opinion is different from yours.
drills.explain: different 的书面固定搭配是 from，yours 替代 your opinion，避免重复。

drills.stem: He is three years senior ___ me, though he looks younger.
drills.answer: to
drills.explain: senior 是拉丁比较级，固定搭配 to；表年龄差时前置 three years 即可，不需要 than。
drills.trap: than 是普通比较级的搭配，senior 这类 -ior 结尾的词一律不接 than。

items.title: more than / no more than / not more than
items.brief: 一个说多，一个说少，一个只说上限

concept.summary: 判定标准：三者的差别在“否定的对象”不同。more than 表多于；no more than 否定数量并强调少，意思是“只有”；not more than 只陈述客观上限，意思是“不多于”。修饰形容词时，no more ... than 表示“两者同样不”，not more ... than 表示“前者不如后者”。

sections.p: 这一组只在名词或数词前使用，语义差别来自 no 与 not 的作用范围：no 否定整个数量，not 只否定“超过”这一部分。
bullets: more than 30 = 三十多个（多于三十）
no more than 30 = 只有三十个（强调少）
not more than 30 = 不超过三十个（客观上限，不带感情）
no less than 30 = 多达三十个（强调多）；not less than 30 = 不少于三十个

sections.h: 程度用法：两者同样不 vs 前者不如
sections.p: 修饰形容词时，no more ... than 是把两个主语一起否定，not more ... than 才是程度上的比较。这是本章最易错的一组，判断依据是句子后半能否译成“两者都不”。
bullets: He is no more careful than his brother.（两人都不细心）
He is not more careful than his brother.（他不如哥哥细心，哥哥可能细心）
no more ... than = not ... any more than
类似结构：no better than = 和…一样不好

sections.p: more than 还可表示“不止是、非常”，此时不构成比较，也不能换成 no more than。识别方法是看后面接的是数量还是名词性质。
bullets: He is more than a teacher to us.（不止是老师）
I am more than happy to help.（非常乐意）
more than once（不止一次）
no more than a teacher = 只不过是个老师（贬低）

examples.en: There were no more than thirty people at the meeting, so the hall felt empty.
examples.zh: 会上只有三十个人，所以大厅显得空。
examples.note: no more than 强调数量少，与“显得空”一致。

examples.en: There were no more thirty people at the meeting.
examples.zh: 会上只有三十个人。
examples.note: no more than 是固定结构，than 不能省略。

examples.en: He is no more careful than his brother; both of them make silly mistakes.
examples.zh: 他并不比他哥哥细心，两人都犯低级错误。
examples.note: no more ... than 表示两者同样不细心。

examples.en: He is not more careful than his brother, but he is certainly more patient.
examples.zh: 他不如哥哥细心，但确实更有耐心。
examples.note: not more ... than 是程度比较，表示前者不如后者。

examples.en: I am more than happy to help you with the project.
examples.zh: 我非常乐意帮你做这个项目。
examples.note: more than + 形容词表示“非常”，不构成比较。

examples.en: No less than fifty students attended the lecture.
examples.zh: 多达五十名学生听了讲座。
examples.note: no less than 强调数量多，与 no more than 的“少”相反。

examples.en: No more than fifty students attended the lecture, which shows how popular it was.
examples.zh: 只有五十名学生听了讲座，这说明讲座很受欢迎。
examples.note: no more than 强调“只有、少”，与“很受欢迎”矛盾；强调多须换成 no less than。

examples.en: The project took not more than three weeks.
examples.zh: 这个项目用了不超过三周时间。
examples.note: not more than 只陈述上限，不含“只有”的强调。

pitfalls.wrong: He is not more careful than his brother; neither of them is careful.
pitfalls.right: He is no more careful than his brother; neither of them is careful.
pitfalls.why: not more ... than 只表示程度较低，推不出“两人都不”；要表达两者同样不，须用 no more ... than。

pitfalls.wrong: He earned no more than 3000 yuan a month and was proud of the high pay.
pitfalls.right: He earned no more than 3000 yuan a month and complained about the low pay.
pitfalls.why: no more than 强调“少”，与“为高薪自豪”自相矛盾；强调多要用 no less than。

pitfalls.wrong: He is no more than a teacher to us; we all respect him deeply.
pitfalls.right: He is more than a teacher to us; we all respect him deeply.
pitfalls.why: no more than a teacher 意为“只不过是个老师”，带贬低意味，与“深受尊敬”冲突。

contrast.diff: 比较级表最高级靠排除主语实现“最”；no more than 靠否定数量实现“只有”，两者都含否定义但作用对象不同。

concept.mnemonic: no 否数量（只有），not 否超过（不超过）；no more 两头都不，not more 前者不如。

core: more than 30 = 多于三十
no more than 30 = 只有三十（强调少）
not more than 30 = 不超过三十（客观上限）
no more ... than = 两者同样不；not more ... than = 前者不如后者
no less than 强调多；more than + 形容词 = 非常
review.trigger: 看到 no/not + more than → 先问否定的是数量还是“超过” → 再定译文

quickCheck.q: no more than 与 not more than 的差别？
quickCheck.a: 前者强调“只有”，后者只表“不超过”。

quickCheck.q: He is no more careful than his brother 是什么意思？
quickCheck.a: 他和他哥哥一样不细心。

quickCheck.q: “非常乐意”用 more than 怎么说？
quickCheck.a: more than happy to do sth。

drills.stem: There were ___ thirty people at the meeting, so the hall felt empty.
drills.answer: no more than
drills.explain: 后半句“大厅显得空”说明说话人强调人少，no more than 正是“只有”的意思。
drills.trap: not more than 只陈述上限，不含“少得可怜”的强调，无法解释“显得空”的评价。

drills.stem: He is ___ more careful than his brother; both of them are careless.
drills.answer: no
drills.hint: 后半句说两人都粗心，说明前半句是否定两个人。
drills.explain: no more ... than 表示两者同样不，与“两人都粗心”一致；not more 只能表示前者不如后者。

drills.stem: He is not more careful than his brother; neither of them checks the data.
drills.answer: He is no more careful than his brother; neither of them checks the data.
accept: He is no more careful than his brother; neither of them checks the data.
drills.explain: neither of them 说明两人都不细心，须用 no more ... than 表示两者同样不。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The project took no more than three weeks.
drills.explain: no more than + 数词表示“只有”，强调用时少。

drills.stem: 他并不比我细心。
drills.answer: He is no more careful than I am.
drills.explain: 句意是“两人都不细心”，须用 no more ... than；not more ... than 会变成“他不如我细心”。

drills.stem: I am ___ happy to help you with the project.
drills.answer: more than
drills.explain: more than + 形容词表示“非常”，是固定用法，不构成比较。
drills.trap: no more than happy 意为“并不比…更高兴”，与“非常乐意”的语义完全相反。

items.title: 倍数的三种表达
items.brief: 三个公式各有槽位，as、of、than 不能混搭

concept.summary: 判定标准：倍数由“倍数词 + 比较结构”构成，三种写法语义相同——倍数 + as + 形容词原级 + as、倍数 + the size/length/weight of、倍数 + 比较级 + than。每个公式的槽位固定：as 必须成对、the size 后接 of、比较级后接 than，混搭即错。

sections.p: 倍数词放在最前面，后面接哪一种结构都可以，语义基本一致。倍数词包括 twice、three times、four times，以及 half、one third 等分数。
bullets: A is three times as large as B.（A 是 B 的三倍大）
A is three times the size of B.（A 的大小是 B 的三倍）
A is three times larger than B.（严格解读为“大四倍”，考试多按“是三倍”处理）
A is twice as heavy as B. / A is twice the weight of B.

sections.p: 三种公式内部各自闭合，不能把一种公式的头接到另一种公式的尾上。改错题常在此处设错，判断办法是数“连接词”的个数。
bullets: × three times as larger as：as 后必须用原级 large
× three times the size as B：the size 后必须接 of
× three times more as B：比较级 more 后必须接 than
√ three times as large as / three times the size of / three times larger than

sections.h: 倍数句同样要求对象对称
sections.p: 倍数只是把差距量化，比较对象仍须同类。前项是“某地的人口”，后项也要是人口，不能直接接国家名。
bullets: The population of China is about four times that of the United States.
× The population of China is four times as large as the United States.
The output of this factory is now three times that of 2010.
倍数 + that of 是把 the size of 公式与替代词结合的最简写法

examples.en: This room is three times as large as that one.
examples.zh: 这个房间是那个房间的三倍大。
examples.note: times as + 原级 + as，三个槽位齐全。

examples.en: This room is three times as larger as that one.
examples.zh: 这个房间是那个房间的三倍大。
examples.note: as...as 中间必须用形容词原级，larger 是比较级，应改为 large。

examples.en: The new bridge is twice the length of the old one.
examples.zh: 新桥的长度是旧桥的两倍。
examples.note: 倍数 + the length of，length 是表维度的名词。

examples.en: The new bridge is twice the length as the old one.
examples.zh: 新桥的长度是旧桥的两倍。
examples.note: the length 后必须接 of，不能接 as。

examples.en: This box is three times heavier than that one.
examples.zh: 这个箱子比那个箱子重三倍。
examples.note: 倍数 + 比较级 + than，是三种公式之一。

examples.en: The population of China is about four times that of the United States.
examples.zh: 中国的人口大约是美国的四倍。
examples.note: 倍数 + that of，that 替代 the population，比较对象对称。

examples.en: The output of this factory is now three times that of 2010.
examples.zh: 这家工厂现在的产量是 2010 年的三倍。
examples.note: that 替代 the output，避免产量与年份相比。

pitfalls.wrong: This box is three times as heavier as that one.
pitfalls.right: This box is three times as heavy as that one.
pitfalls.why: as...as 之间只能用原级，heavier 是比较级，与 as 的槽位冲突。

pitfalls.wrong: The population of China is four times as large as the United States.
pitfalls.right: The population of China is four times that of the United States.
pitfalls.why: 人口不能与国家的面积或整体相比，须用 that of 补出 the population。

pitfalls.wrong: The hall is twice the size as the classroom.
pitfalls.right: The hall is twice the size of the classroom.
pitfalls.why: the size 属名词短语结构，后面固定接 of，不能接 as。

contrast.diff: 该知识点处理倍数词本身的构成（twice、three times、分数）；本知识点处理倍数与比较结构如何拼接，重点在槽位不能混搭。

concept.mnemonic: as 要成对，of 跟 size，than 跟比较级；倍数放最前，槽位不串门。

core: 倍数 + as + 原级 + as
倍数 + the size/length/weight/height + of
倍数 + 比较级 + than
as 后必须原级，the size 后必须 of，比较级后必须 than
倍数句仍需对象对称：four times that of the US
review.trigger: 看到 times + 形容词 → 先确认走的是 as...as、the size of 还是比较级 than

quickCheck.a: three times as large as / three times the size of / three times larger than。

quickCheck.q: three times as larger as 错在哪？
quickCheck.a: as 后必须用原级 large。

quickCheck.q: “中国人口是美国的四倍”怎么说？
quickCheck.a: The population of China is four times that of the United States。

drills.stem: This room is three times ___ that one.
drills.answer: as large as
drills.explain: times as + 形容词原级 + as 是同级比较的倍数公式，as 必须成对出现。
drills.trap: as larger as 把比较级塞进 as...as 的槽位，原级位置只能放 large。

drills.stem: The new bridge is twice ___ length of the old one.
drills.answer: the
drills.hint: 倍数 + ___ + 维度名词 + of。
drills.explain: the length of 是固定名词短语结构，表维度时必须带定冠词 the。

drills.stem: This box is three times as heavier as that one.
drills.answer: This box is three times as heavy as that one.
accept: This box is three times as heavy as that one.
drills.explain: as...as 之间只能放形容词原级，heavier 是比较级，须改为 heavy。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The population of China is about four times that of the United States.
drills.explain: 倍数 four times 后接 that of，that 替代 the population，使比较对象保持对称。

drills.stem: 这台机器的重量是那台的三倍。
drills.answer: This machine is three times as heavy as that one.
drills.explain: 三种公式任选其一，但槽位必须闭合：as...as 用原级，the weight 后接 of。

drills.stem: The output of this factory is now ___ of 2010.
drills.answer: three times that
drills.explain: output 是不可数名词，用 that 替代，构成 three times that of 2010，表示产量是 2010 年的三倍。
drills.trap: three times those 用复数替代词，与不可数的 output 不一致。
